sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL AND T1.month > 0, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL AND T1.month > 0, 1, 0))) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name), IIF(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL AND T1.month > 0, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL AND T1.month > 0, 1, 0)) > 0, 'YES', 'NO') AS isHigh FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 LEFT JOIN disabled AS T2 ON T2.name = T1.name
SELECT AVG(T1.month) FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 INNER JOIN disabled AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN male AS T3 ON T3.name = T2.name
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy AS T1 INNER JOIN no_payment_due AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.bool = 'pos'
SELECT bool FROM no_payment_due WHERE name = 'student124'
SELECT T1.name FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 INNER JOIN no_payment_due AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.bool = 'neg' AND T1.month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM longest_absense_from_school)
SELECT T1.name FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 INNER JOIN no_payment_due AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.bool = 'neg' AND T1.month = 5
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM enlist AS T1 INNER JOIN filed_for_bankrupcy AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.organ = 'navy'
SELECT bool FROM no_payment_due WHERE name = 'student299'
SELECT COUNT(name) FROM longest_absense_from_school WHERE month > 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM disabled AS T1 INNER JOIN no_payment_due AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.bool = 'pos'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy AS T1 INNER JOIN enrolled AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.school = 'occ'
SELECT T1.name FROM disabled AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.organ = 'navy'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T4.name) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.name) FROM enlist AS T1 INNER JOIN person AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN enrolled AS T3 ON T3.name = T2.name LEFT JOIN male AS T4 ON T2.name = T4.name WHERE T3.school = 'ucla' AND T1.organ = 'air_force'

SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.school = 'uci' AND T4.name IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.name) FROM enrolled AS T1 INNER JOIN person AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN disabled AS T3 ON T2.name = T3.name LEFT JOIN male AS T4 ON T2.name = T4.name
SELECT name FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'marines'
SELECT COUNT(name) FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'navy'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM unemployed AS T1 INNER JOIN no_payment_due AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.bool = 'pos'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM disabled AS T1 INNER JOIN longest_absense_from_school AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.month = 0
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.organ = 'marines'

SELECT T.month FROM (SELECT T1.month, COUNT(T1.name) AS num FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.organ = 'air_force' GROUP BY T1.month) T ORDER BY T.num DESC LIMIT 1
